body:
Path: P2 | 服务端逐草稿告警被三处静默丢弃 | 北极星「优先级」4

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) while reviewing PR objectui#10038, which closes objectui#6965. ⛔ Not graded here — an execution seat does not grade or route.

## What objectui#6965 fixed, and what it did not

objectui#6965 named **two** client call sites that fire `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts` outside the reporting seam, and PR objectui#10038 routes both through `MetadataClient.publishPackageDrafts`, so the server's per-draft advisories now reach the author there.

⭐ **There are three more**, and they still drop every advisory the server sends. Enumerated by the reviewing seat on objectui `origin/main` `030a675b0` at 2026-09-19T19:14Z — the full list, reconciled against its own row count, ⛔ not a truncated one:

| call site | state |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` | ✅ routed by PR objectui#10038 |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` | ✅ routed by PR objectui#10038 |
| `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx` | ⛔ still a bare `fetch` |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` | ⛔ still a bare `fetch` |
| `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` | ⛔ still a bare `fetch` |

Enumeration control: 9 non-test rows matched the route in `packages/app-shell/src` + `apps/console/src`, over 11 files including tests — the instrument sees more than the five rows above, so the five are a reading rather than a ceiling.

## Same defect, same fix shape

Each of the three is the identical shape objectui#6965 documented: a bare `fetch` to the batch route, so the `published[].advisories` the server now sends (declared in the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` as `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.published[].advisories`) are parsed by nobody and the author sees nothing. The fix is the one PR objectui#10038 already built: call `client.publishPackageDrafts(...)`.

⛔ They were left out of PR objectui#10038 deliberately: the dispatch declared a four-file face and said not to widen it. ⇒ This is objectui#6965's completion scope, not a new discovery about the mechanism.

## ⚠️ Serial constraint — read this before dispatching

**Two of the three files are in flight right now.** objectui#7373 (`claude/issue-7373-home-redirect-declared-landing`, claimed by the same seat at 2026-09-19T19:14Z) declares a file face that includes `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `AiChatPage.tsx`. ⇒ This card must be **serialized after** objectui#7373 lands, or it will collide in two of its three files. `PendingDraftsBar.tsx` is free.

## 查重词
